A '''totem pole''' was a large wooden column made up of sculptures of various creatures which sat atop one another. The [[Totem Master]] claimed that villages on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] made use of totem poles as symbolic safeguards against the forces of evil. The [[Lizard Warrior]]s of the [[Valley of the Lizard Warriors]] used totem poles to mark the boundaries of their land, but whether they were also meant to ward off evil spirits was unknown.

The totem pole that the Totem Master would bring from village to village was actually made up of real beings, who the he had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] through the use of a [[Totem Master's ring|magic ring]]. When pointing his ring at other creatures, the Totem Master could fire a bolt of energy which would change the creature into a solid block of wood. After stacking his slaves on top of each other, the Totem Master could claim that the structure was nothing more than a simple totem pole and not his unwilling slaves. The creatures that made up the Totem Master's totem pole included a [[Unidentified green arthropod|green arthropod]], a [[Unidentified blue biped|blue biped]], and a [[Unidentified brown biped|brown biped]]. The Totem Master would leave his totem pole with unsuspecting villagers, and when night fell, his [[Totem slaves|Totem Slaves]] would break from the pole and proceed to ransack their village.

[[File:TotemTheTotem.jpg|thumb|150px|The Totem Master is turned into a totem pole.]]
Following a robbery of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], the Totem Master added two more to his totem pole, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]. After bringing his totem pole to the next village, the [[Strutters' Village|Strutter's]], the Totem Master was attacked by the Ewoks, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], who had come to rescue their friends. In an ensuing chase, the Totem Master accidentally turned himself into a totem, which removed his spell and freed his slaves.
